Proudly established Family Business on the Gold Coast, Action Sheetmetal and Roofing’s history stretches back to the 1990’s. Through partnerships and our relationships, everything we do is to improve someone's quality of life - no matter how simply. We assist designers, architects, builders and engineers in the design and fabrication of their sheetmetal requirements. We specialise in stainless steel and aluminium products and also provide metal roofing and rainwater goods.

For more information about Action Sheetmetal and Roofing, and the services we provide, please visit our website at www.actionsheetmetal.com

We are seeking experienced DRAFTSPERSONS to join our busy workshop on a full time and permanent basis.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Follow specifications and calculations to create various technical drawings
Prepare both rough sketches and detailed design work with CADD systems
Calculate dimensions, weight limitations and requirements in materials
Outline the construction process of the project on the technical drawings
Communicate with architects and engineers, and incorporating knowledge gained into drawings.
Prepare, review and redraft alongside the engineering team.
Ensure final designs are compliant with AS/NZ & ISO standards, including building regulations
Carry out design and development of products, including verification and validation of designs
Identify and communicate potential design problems to the rest of the team.
Keeping abreast of the latest developments and technologies in CADD systems/software.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
At least more than 4-years of experience in CADD
Profound knowledge in CAD software e.g AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong organisational and time management skills
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

Voyages Tourism Australia requires 4 workers to work within our Front Office Department as a Guest Service Agent, assisting guests with their luggage, offering information and support and ensuring a smooth and welcoming experience from arrival to departure located in Yulara, NT. 

The day-to-day duties may include:
-Serve as an ambassador of the resort, ensuring all guests feel welcomed upon arrival and are bid farewell with kindness at departure, enhancing guest satisfaction throughout their stay.
- Efficiently and accurately process all check-ins and check-outs.
- Ensure all hotel charges are accurately processed to guests’ accounts, with pre-authorizations taken for each account, guaranteeing bills are correct and payments are securely handled.
- Deliver a high standard of quality service by promptly and effectively responding to all guest inquiries, bookings, and complaints with exceptional customer service.

You will be required to use tools and equipment such as computer, two way radio, telephone, motor vehicle, trolley, vacuum, work individually and in a team with others, and have the ability to work quickly and with accuracy. 

The work is physical, and you may be required to work in a harsh desert environment with temperatures that range from 12 to 45 degrees Celsius.

You will be employed on a full-time basis of $29.63 per hour under the terms and conditions of the Voyages Tourism Australia Pty Ltd Enterprise Agreement 2016 (Resort Worker Level 2) and receive a minimum of 38 hours per week. 

The work is usually performed between the hours of 06:00 to 23:00, Monday to Sunday as this role requires shift work, weekends and Public Holiday’s. 

Work is expected to commence on or around August 2026 for a period of 4 years.

Experience is preferred but not essential, as training will be provided. Successful candidates may also have the opportunity to learn and acquire additional skills during their employment.
 
Candidates should be motivated and be able to learn quickly. 

(This opportunity is with Voyages Tourism Australia, formerly known as Voyages Indigenous Tourism Australia)

Our client, Alpha Luxury Rental Pty Ltd T/A CABBAGE TREE POINT GENERAL STORE & BOAT HIRE, is seeking a passionate and experienced Retail Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of their store. This full-time position is ideal for a motivated professional who enjoys leading a team, delivering exceptional customer experiences, and ensuring the store operates efficiently while achieving business objectives.

Job Title
•	Retail Manager 

Job Responsibility
•	Manage the overall retail operations of the store while maintaining high standards of customer service, profitability and operational excellence.
Duties
•	Monitor daily sales activities and adjust product offerings to meet customer demand and seasonal trading patterns.
•	Manage inventory levels by forecasting stock requirements, coordinating supplier deliveries and reducing stock wastage.
•	Establish customer service expectations and ensure the team consistently delivers a welcoming and efficient in-store experience.
•	Plan and coordinate promotional activities, local marketing campaigns and in-store merchandising to increase customer engagement and sales.
•	Provide customers with product information and recommendations while supporting the sales team during busy trading periods.
•	Maintain accurate records relating to stock movements, daily sales, cash handling and other financial transactions.
•	Prepare and monitor store budgets, review operating costs and implement initiatives to improve profitability.
•	Recruit new employees, organise staff induction and training, allocate daily work responsibilities and oversee employee performance.
•	Prepare staff rosters to ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained in line with business requirements.
•	Ensure the store complies with workplace health and safety requirements, food safety standards and company operating procedures.
•	Review business performance reports, identify opportunities for operational improvements and implement strategies to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.

Qualification
•	AQF Diploma or higher.
•	1-3 years of experience in related field.

Salary
•	$75,000 – $90,000 + Superannuation.

Employment Condition
•	Full Time 
•	38 hours per week.

Position Classification: Nurse Manager Grade 3
Remuneration: $79.81 - $81.29 per hour, plus superannuation
Hours Per Week: As required
Requisition ID: REQ674658
Located in: Randwick, Sydney

Applications close date: 19 July 2026

Come Work With Us!

The vision for South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD) is 'exceptional care, healthier lives'. SESLHD is committed to enabling our community to be healthy and well, and to providing the best possible compassionate care when people need it.

Experienced Registered Nurse-Nurse Manager or looking to further develop your leadership and management skills in a highly supported environment? This casual role may be for you. You can work shifts according to your availability and current commitments.

This exciting position is responsible for supporting all services within Eastern Suburbs Mental Health Service after hours, the role will lead the operational management and provide professional guidance and clinical expertise to all the areas with the ESMHS. This position will ensure efficient patient flow and access whilst supporting and managing incidences across the site. It is a senior nursing role who will work in collaboration with the senior leadership team at ESMHS.

Participates as a member of the Eastern Suburbs Mental Health management team, responsible for: 

Effective and efficient leadership and management of the relevant inpatient services

Guiding the delivery of optimal patient care through collaborative partnerships with other teams, services and organisations

Supporting the Eastern Suburbs Mental Health Executive, Nursing Unit Managers and Patient Flow Coordinator in the daily operational activities for the Units 

Involvement in strategic planning, project development and continuous improvement of practice standards and services 

Participating in rostered Executive On Call duties for after-hours and weekends. 

Where you'll be working

Eastern Suburbs Mental Health Service (ESMHS), located on the Prince of Wales Hospital campus, Randwick.

The service is close by to light rail, beaches, cafes and access to a great lifestyle.

Learn more about us here: South Eastern Sydney Local Health District

Additional Information and Benefits

Up to 12 allocated days off each year (for full-time employees) in addition to annual leave. 

Salary packaging options that reduce your taxable income and increase your take-home pay! Up to $9K for living expenses and $2.6K meal & entertainment & Novated Leasing.

Discounted gym memberships with a Fitness Passport

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for employees and family members

Discounted Private Health Insurance.

Opportunity to apply for Continuing Education allowance based on tertiary qualifications attained where applicable.

Opportunity to obtain personal regrade to Clinical Nurse Specialist Grade 1 status where relevant.

Position Requirements:

Tertiary qualifications in Nursing and current registration as a Registered Nurse with the Nursing & Midwifery Board of Australia.

Demonstrated extensive post-registration experience in mental health nursing with management experience and experience in acute mental health care.

Demonstrated excellent communication (written and verbal), interpersonal, organisational and problem-solving skills.

Demonstrated ability to undertake clinical service planning, change management and financial management.

Knowledge of Work Health and Safety and Injury Management, security, risk, and safety management, associated with acute mental health service.

Understanding of and commitment to consumer and carer consultation and participation in service planning and delivery.

Sound knowledge of Performance Management and Industrial Relations Processes.

Computer literacy and current drivers licence (or a willingness to travel in accordance with the demands of the position)
